name: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited
summary: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited manufactures and supplies reinforced polypropylene compounds, thermoplastics elastomers, and personal protective equipment masks and gloves in India. It also offers engineering plastics including ABS, HIPS, PA, PBT, PC and their alloys; biodegradable nitrile gloves and protective coverall; thermoplastic elastomers under the HYPRENE brand name; POM and LFT products; fiberglass honeycomb composite panels; polypropylene products; PA6/PA66 products; engineering plastics compounds; and high temperature resistant nylon/LCP. The company was formerly known as Hydro S&S Industries Limited and changed its name to Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited in March 2016. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Pune, India. Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited is a subsidiary of M/s Kingfa Science & Technology Co. Ltd China.
